target: realize C=K, and hence a charging form proportional to n^T K^-1 n, using positive diagonal capacitors behind an ideal signed linear transformer

factorization.algorithm: exact rational unpivoted LDL^T in the recorded channel order
factorization.energyIdentity: (1/2) dot(x)^T D dot(x)=(1/2) dot(phi)^T K dot(phi)

interpretation.recovery: the capacitor-only node no-go does not force active energy injection: an ideal lossless signed mode transformer followed by 24 positive capacitors realizes the exact quadratic form
interpretation.cost: the particular exact factor is dense, using 242 of 276 possible lower-triangular mixing coefficients, so physical layout, bandwidth, parasitics and transformer synthesis become the next bottleneck
interpretation.measurement: measure the 24-port small-signal capacitance/admittance matrix and compare every entry with a globally scaled K before adding Josephson nonlinearities
interpretation.passRule: after one fitted positive global scale, the residual matrix must lie inside a preregistered fabrication-and-readout error norm and remain positive definite
interpretation.failMeaning: the proposed mixing network does not implement the dual Leech quadratic form; downstream pendulum and edge claims do not inherit Leech provenance

established: an exact passive-component recovery exists in the ideal signed-transformer abstraction, with positive capacitances spanning only a factor of 16 and transformer coefficients of magnitude at most one half
boundary: This is an algebraic network synthesis, not a fabricated circuit. Ideal multiport transformer coordinates are an extra resource; the record does not supply a planar local layout, finite-bandwidth implementation, parasitic tolerance, quantum-noise budget or proof that the full Josephson/coupled-wire device flows to the Leech edge.
